summary.text: Tammy Phelps is a Democratic member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 3 (Caddo Parish), and was elected in 2019, according to the official House member page.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Tammy Phelps's occupation as Education Administrator.
It lists education as Captain Shreve High School; M.B.A., Strategic Leadership, Amberton University; B.S., Business Administration, Louisiana Tech University.

The page lists committee assignments including Insurance, Labor and Industrial Relations, Transportation, Highways and Public Works, and the House Select Committee on Women and Children, and caucus affiliations including the Democratic Caucus, the Louisiana Legislative Black Caucus and the Louisiana Legislative Women's Caucus.
